# Template: plain-English notice for instructors aged 15 to 17

---

**Your information at [centre name] — the short version**

- **What we keep about you:** your name, email and phone, your date of birth, the
  sailing and first-aid certificates you hold, when you can work, the shifts you do, the
  hours you work and your pay. We also keep a parent or guardian's name and phone, and
  their written permission for you to work here.
- **Why:** so we can put you on the right courses, keep everyone safe on the water, make
  sure your hours stay inside the rules for your age, and pay you.
- **Who can see it:** the centre managers [and the welfare officer]. Other instructors can
  see your name and your shift times, but not your phone number or email.
- **Where it lives:** in ActivityRoster, a rostering app we use. It's stored in the UK/EU
  and nobody sells it or uses it for adverts.
- **Messages:** you'll only get rota and group notices. Nobody at the centre should
  message you privately through the app, because it doesn't do that.
- **How long:** while you work with us and for about a year after, in case you come back.
- **Your choices:** you can see what we hold, ask us to fix mistakes, or ask us to delete
  it. Talk to [name], or your parent or guardian can ask for you.
